case_title: AMERICAN CHECK EXCHANGE DBA ANYKIND CHECK CASHING VS COMBS RICKEY

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $300.00 FILED BY AMERICAN CHECK EXCHANGE DBA ANYKIND CHECK CASHING CENTER AS TO DEFENDANT COMBS RICKEY ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAY-14-1993 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 03
SUBSTITUTED PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT COMBS RICKEY

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF AMERICAN CHECK EXCHANGE DBA ANYKIND CHECK CASHING CENTER RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT COMBS RICKEY $300.00 PRINCIPAL, $60.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $360.00 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
